videos.headline: Michigan beats Wisconsin for Big Ten tournament title
videos.description: Michigan gets late free throws and good defense to hold off Wisconsin and win the Big Ten.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCB Highlight (Michigan beats Wisconsin for Big Ten tournament title) 2025/03/16 ESHEET

videos.headline: Wisconsin's Klesmit splashes home long 3
videos.description: Max Klesmit steps into the long 3-pointer and knocks it down for Wisconsin.

tracking.trackingName: NCB_One-Play (Wisconsin’s Klesmit splashes home long 3) 2025/03/16 ESHEET

videos.headline: John Blackwell hits tough jumper off the spin move
videos.description: John Blackwell spins in the paint and hits the jumper over the defender.

videos.headline: Tre Donaldson loses man after picking up his gum
videos.description: Tre Donaldson loses his gum during live play, and his defender goes back-door on him when he goes to pick it up.
